question: What is the theme of International Happiness Day (IHD) 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Caring and Sharing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• International Happiness Day being observed globally with theme ‘Caring & Sharing’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **International Happiness Day (IHD)** is observed globally to recognize the importance of **happiness** and **well-being** as **universal goals** in human lives.
 
• The theme of **IHD** this year is **Caring and Sharing**, emphasizing the need for a more **inclusive** and **balanced approach** to economic growth and well-being.
 
• The **United Nations** proclaimed **20 March** as **International Day of Happiness** in its **2012 General Assembly resolution**.
 
• To mark the occasion, the **United Nations** released the **World Happiness Report 2025**, highlighting case studies and global analyses of **happiness** and **kindness**.
 
• The report also discusses how **sharing meals** supports **happiness** and fosters **social connections**.
